title: Which load gets the most power?
cover: Which load gets the most power?

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Which speaker gets the most power?
short_scenes.narration: Volt wants the loudest speaker for his amplifier. Which resistance gets the most power?
Watch the power curve as the load changes. It peaks exactly when the load equals the source's own resistance.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Too small or too big is bad!
short_scenes.narration: A very small load gets lots of current but almost no voltage. A very big load gets voltage but almost no current. The best balance is when the load matches the source.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: But at that point, efficiency is only fifty percent.

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.say: Watch the full video: Maximum power transfer!
short_scenes.narration: For the detailed explanation, watch the full video on our channel. It's part of our complete Network Theory course.
